    The cone of a right approximation, shifted back one degree, belongs to add(T) under the two vanishing conditions used in the Bongartz presentation.

    ∃ (A : C) (B : C) (i : A ⟶ B) (p : B ⟶ Y) (δ : Y ⟶ (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor C 1).obj A), CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk i p δ ∈ CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles ∧ IsInAdd A T ∧ IsInAdd B T

    A basis of the finite-dimensional Hom space gives a right approximation by a finite sum of T. Its fiber gives a presentation with both terms in add(T).

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_bongartz_presentation (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] (U : TwoTerm R) (hu : U.IsPresilting) :
    ∃ (B : TwoTerm R), have T := U.directSum B; T.IsPresilting ∧ (∀ (X : TwoTerm R), T.InThick X) ∧ ∀ (Y : TwoTerm R), Function.Surjective ⇑(U.homotopyBoundary Y) → ∃ (A : HomotopyCategory (FGModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) (D : HomotopyCategory (FGModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) (i : A ⟶ D) (p : D ⟶ Y.homotopyObject) (δ : Y.homotopyObject ⟶ (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor (HomotopyCategory (FGModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) 1).obj A), CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk i p δ ∈ CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles ∧ IsInAdd A T.homotopyObject ∧ IsInAdd D T.homotopyObject

    Every right-orthogonal Y has a presentation by the Bongartz completion of U. One completion works for all such Y.
